verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents a full RESTful API for driving applicant verification, webhooks for events, sandbox testing, and even an official MCP server enabling AI agents to perform operations under existing role permissions. This directly satisfies the AI-native driving-via-documented-API story, though no public OpenAPI/Swagger spec was found in probes. Missing for 10: publicly discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent third-party corroboration of API robustness.
